To examine the issue beyond uncertain retrospective judgments.
To replace all self-ratings with intelligence tests.
To follow the same parents from birth.

questions.prompt: Why does the author say he is borrowing Tim Wilson's terminology?

To claim he coined the term before Wilson did.
To identify Tim Wilson as the sole author of the Wilson and Ross paper.

vocabulary.meaning: 术语；某领域或作者使用的概念名称

questions.translation: Wilson和Ross把论文题为《从笨手到能手：人们对过去与现在自我的评价》。把过去的自己看作不太自信、不太善交际或不太独立，我们就能觉得现在的自己在这些方面强得多。借用Tim Wilson的术语，我们一直在编辑自己的故事。贬低过去的自我就是一种编辑方法。

questions.prompt: What does 'derogation of the past self' involve?
questions.promptZh: derogation of the past self 涉及什么？
options: Making the past self seem superior to the present in every respect.
Removing every memory regardless of whether it is good or bad.
Viewing the past self less favourably so that the present can seem improved.
Proving by definition that every real skill has objectively improved.
optionsZh: 把过去自己说得每方面都胜过现在。
不论好坏删除一切记忆。
把过去自我看得较低，从而显得现在有所进步。
按定义证明每种实际能力都客观提高。
analyses: A derogation是贬低过去，非抬高过去压低现在。
B 改变评价不等于删除全部记忆。
C 前句old selves not particularly...current stronger给出运作逻辑，one说明只是一种编辑方式。
D 感到进步与实际能力客观提高不是同义，前面实际记录和回忆比较正提醒这种差别。

questions.passage: We can derogate our past self in many domains, from maturity to writing skills to morality. One area where story editing is difficult to implement is in objective performance. For instance, if you are a marathon runner of my age, you know exactly how you did ten years ago, five years ago, and last month. The record might look something like 2:31 ten years ago, 2:39 five years ago, and 2:48 last month.
questions.prompt: How broad is the range in which the author says past selves can be derogated?
questions.promptZh: 作者说贬低过去自我的范围有多广？
options: It is confined only to marathon times.
It is restricted solely to college GPA.
It extends across several domains, including maturity, writing skills, and morality.
It concerns only the number of books someone owns.
optionsZh: 只限马拉松用时。
仅限大学GPA。
跨多个领域，包括成熟程度、写作能力与道德。

B 学业是随后例子，不是本句排他定义。
C many domains与from...to...to...列举保留非单一领域范围。
